title: [Bug]: Unable to enable prefix caching for glm-4 model (not -hf versions)
bodyExcerpt:

</details>


### Model Input Dumps

_No response_

### 🐛 Describe the bug

With glm-4 model, prefix caching is automatically disabled, because the engine is treating it as MLLM.

Maybe related to following codes:

https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d427e5cfda8d2536b81e6021128e71b2dbc281aa/vllm/model_executor/models/chatglm.py#L758-L782
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d427e5cfda8d2536b81e6021128e71b2dbc281aa/vllm/engine/arg_utils.py#L1046-L1051

Unfortunately, the glm-4 and glm-4v models have the same `model_type` value, how can I override this behavior without changing the code?

### Before submitting a new issue...

author: Jeremy-Hibiki

summary.headlineZh: GLM-4 无法启用前缀缓存
summary.summaryZh: 非 HF 版本 GLM-4 模型的前缀缓存：使用 GLM-4 模型时，vLLM 将其识别为 MLLM，导致前缀缓存被自动禁用。GLM-4 与 GLM-4V 具有相同的 model_type，用户无法在不修改代码的情况下覆盖该行为；影响 GLM-4 模型使用前缀缓存
summary.impactScopeZh: GLM-4 推理场景的前缀缓存配置。
evidence: 【标题】Unable to enable prefix caching for glm-4 model (not -hf versions)
【正文】With glm-4 model, prefix caching is automatically disabled, because the engine is treating it as MLLM.
